title: Road2HireCareerReadinessAnnotationRecord
description: Schema for standardized, evidence-grounded human career readiness annotations for Road2Hire M4.3.

annotation_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the annotation record, e.g. 'mr_101__software_developer__ann'.

pair_id.description: Exact pair_id referencing the CandidateOccupationRecord in candidate_occupation_dataset.jsonl.

candidate_source.description: Repository origin of the candidate profile.

target_occupation_uri.description: Canonical ESCO occupation concept URI, e.g. 'http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/f2b15a0e-e65a-438a-affb-29b9d50b77d1'.

target_occupation_title.description: Canonical ESCO occupation preferred label, e.g. 'software developer'.

readiness_label.description: The assigned career readiness category for the candidate relative to the target occupation (null when unannotated/Draft).

confidence.description: Subjective confidence of the annotator based on the clarity and completeness of candidate evidence (null when unannotated/Draft).

evidence.description: Structured evaluation of independent evidence dimensions.

essential_skill_proficiency.description: Assessment of candidate's grasp over core essential skills required by the occupation.

work_experience_relevance.description: Relevance, duration, and seniority of prior professional work history.

practical_application_evidence.description: Direct proof of hands-on skill application in deployed projects or workplace responsibilities.

education_relevance.description: Relevance of academic degree or formal technical education.

certifications_observed.description: List of verified or stated industry certifications observed.

key_evidence_summary.description: Factual 1-3 sentence summary detailing the critical evidence that determined the label.

candidate_profile_summary.description: Factual profile snapshot (skills, work history, projects, degrees) provided to guide the human annotator.

reviewer_status.description: Audit workflow status for the annotation record.

annotator_id.description: Unique identifier of the annotator or subject matter expert (empty when Draft).

annotation_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of annotation completion (empty when Draft).

annotation_notes.description: Reviewer commentary, edge case notes, or reasons for flagging (empty when Draft).
